_comment: Amazon Connect Dashboard Test Runner – all runtime parameters live here.
_description: This file controls every tunable aspect of the test execution pipeline. Override any value via environment variable (see run_connect_tests.py for the mapping) or supply a different config path via --config CLI argument.

iam._comment: IAM role that GitHub Actions OIDC provider assumes. Leave empty to use the environment's existing credentials (e.g. a local development session).

execution._comment: Concurrency and retry settings for test execution.

test_selection._comment: Which tests to run. 'all' runs every test in test_cases.json. Provide an array of test_case_ids to run a subset.

logging._comment: Python logging level for the test runner. Choices: DEBUG | INFO | WARNING | ERROR
